(define (problem zeno-fixture-generated)
  (:domain zeno-travel)
  (:objects
    plane1 - aircraft
    person1 - person
    city0 city1 - city
    fl0 fl1 - flevel
  )
  (:init
    (at plane1 city0)
    (at person1 city0)
    (fuel-level plane1 fl1)
    (next fl0 fl1)
  )
  (:goal (and (at person1 city1)))
)
